method: Bounded table-specific producer plus exact stock union review and readonly committed251 snapshot observation. No repository edits or probes.

rows.notes: No direct variable lifetime field. Different recipe and initializer-temporary lifetimes must remain distinct. Remove Variable.Lifetime phantom rather than guessing one from scope or recipe.
Actual typedef alias writer roslyn_gen_be.c160-170 has underlying type, no independent symbol target. Preserve Alias.UnderlyingType and descriptor.
Union distinguishes type constraint from bit-width constant and frontend-only class-template symbol. No generic expression field. roslyn_types.h123 preserves direct active arms.

rows.retained_alternative: reference target/name_reference; surrounding ordered operator operands; actual member_pointer_value.subobject_id and subobject_path.base_subobject_id
rows.notes: Variable/routine/field/type reference variants have no base-subobject pointer. Field node is operand of dot_field/points_to_field; do not synthesize contextual base onto reference.

rows.retained_alternative: constructor_array_copy; frees_array; is_initializer_list_array; actual target type; repeat constants
rows.notes: No generic DI array flag. Constructor is_array_copy has precise repeated-element argument semantics. Preserve exact distinct flags; do not substitute derived generic flag.
DI has no singular VLA-dimension pointer. Actual array/operation dimension lists and variable element-count storage remain directly navigable.

rows.retained_alternative: initialization_operand.expression_id; actual initialization children for ck_dynamic_init aggregate constants
rows.notes: Constructor args are expression list only. roslyn_gen_be.c199-217 preserves nested aggregate initialization nodes separately; no need to duplicate onto operand row.

rows.retained_alternative: constructor_initializer.field_id; constant.initialized_field_id; actual reference-expression field target
rows.notes: Field target belongs to constructor initializer / optimized empty-object occurrence, not constructor argument entry. Preserve those direct relationships.
Base target belongs to constructor initializer / optimized empty-object occurrence, not argument entry. Preserve exact base links and ordered expression arguments.

limits: Zero counts alone are not removal justification; source definition and actual writer reviewed for every candidate.
Preserve all actual adjacent links/flags; no semantic inference/reconstruction proposed.
This is not a claim that all adjacent conditional alternatives have positive fixtures.
